# Result-stage refinement — Section 4 internal-consistency fix

## Path chosen: (a) — restrict completion_bonus to the near-miss zone (0 < normalized_distance ≤ τ)

**Rationale (≤8 lines).** Path (a) was selected for three converging reasons. (i) Terminological coherence: "completion bonus" naturally reads as a near-miss partial-credit kicker, not an additive on top of an already-correct answer; binding it to `0 < d ≤ τ` matches that semantic. (ii) Invariance restoration: at τ = 0 the bonus-gate predicate is uniformly false, so `reward(MinED)` at τ = 0 collapses to `1 − d` for d = 0 and to floor = 0 for d > 0 — recovering `reward(EM)` pointwise with no ε slack. (iii) Slot (v)'s intended status as the only universally-checkable invariant survives: it remains a strict pointwise equality at ε_sanity = 1e-6 rather than being degraded to a two-mode identity (path b) or a rank-equivalence claim (path c).

## Restated Section 4 slots — corrected and internally consistent

### Slot (iii) Reward formulation — corrected

| Field | Content |
|---|---|
| Locked design-stage default | `reward(pred, gold) = 1 − normalized_distance + ε · completion_bonus`, where `completion_bonus = 1` iff `0 < normalized_distance ≤ τ` AND structural envelope matches gold (length-bucket match AND structural-element-count match for arithmetic / bracket / sorted-word tasks), else 0. If `normalized_distance > τ`, reward collapses to floor = 0. Default ε = 1e-3. |
| Rationale | Near-miss partial credit. At τ = 0 and exact match, predicate `0 < d ≤ 0` is false; bonus = 0; reward = 1.0 exactly, pointwise-equivalent to `reward(EM) = 1`. At non-exact match under τ = 0, the d > τ branch applies, reward = 0 = `reward(EM)`. The bonus operates only over the strict near-miss band where partial credit is meaningful. |
| Source-paper confirmation | pending — definition matches reviewer's correction; exact ε, completion-bonus criterion, and floor value still subject to confirmation |

### Slot (v) Sanity control — corrected

| Field | Content |
|---|---|
| Locked design-stage default | Pre-computation gate: implement MinED with τ = 0 on a 100-pair synthetic batch covering exact matches, off-by-whitespace, off-by-letter, off-by-word, fully-disjoint strings, and structural-envelope-matching near-misses. Assert pointwise `|reward_MinED − reward_EM| ≤ ε_sanity = 1e-6` for each pair. Under corrected (iii), at τ = 0 the bonus-gate predicate is uniformly false and the d > τ branch catches every non-exact match; reward equivalence holds strictly. If any assertion fails, BLOCK downstream run and report failure. |
| Rationale | Slot (v)'s strongest attainable claim — strict pointwise reward equivalence at ε_sanity = 1e-6 — is preserved by path (a) without requiring ε-symmetric slack. The gate remains tier-1 and universally-checkable. |
| Source-paper confirmation | confirmed-as-design-discipline |

## Explanatory note (placed inside Section 4, below the slots table, same section structure as before, no new section added)

> **Refinement note (this revision).** The first version of this design contained an internal contradiction: completion_bonus was defined over *all* envelope-matching cases including exact match, yielding `reward(MinED-{τ=0, exact match}) = 1.0 + ε ≈ 1.001`, three orders of magnitude beyond ε_sanity = 1e-6, which would have caused slot (v) to fail at its tier-1 gate and blocked every downstream run. Following reviewer-flagged inconsistency, completion_bonus is now restricted to the near-miss band `0 < normalized_distance ≤ τ`. Path (a) was selected over (b) — which would have left an asymmetric two-mode ε (main run ε = 1e-3, sanity run ε = 0) — and over (c) — which would have weakened slot (v) from pointwise equality to rank-equivalence — because path (a) makes slot (v) strictly checkable without any ε-internal asymmetry and matches the partial-credit semantics implied by "completion bonus" terminology. The contradiction is closed.

## Sections 1, 2, 3, 5, 6, 7 — unchanged and approved

The reviewer confirmed these sections remain aligned with the original brief, the five review-locks (Lock 1 task composition, Lock 2 single backbone, Lock 3 demonstration protocol, Lock 4 statistical plan, Lock 5 MinED slots), and the design-only track contract. They are inherited verbatim from the prior result-stage handoff and not re-stated here.

## Section 4 (full, with corrected slots iii and v replacing the prior versions)

| Slot | Locked design-stage default | Rationale | Source-paper confirmation |
|---|---|---|---|
| (i) Edit-distance level | **Character-level PRIMARY** (Levenshtein over Unicode codepoints); **BPE/token-level ACCEPTABLE SECONDARY** | Char-level is tokenizer-agnostic and reproducible. BPE-level couples the metric to the backbone tokenizer. | pending |
| (ii) Normalization | `ratio = Levenshtein(pred, gold) / max(\|gold\|, \|prediction\|)` ∈ [0, 1] PRIMARY; raw Levenshtein as SECONDARY reporting | Bounding to [0, 1] yields scale-invariant reward interpretable as "fraction of longer string changed to match shorter". Raw distance preserved for diagnostics. | pending |
| (iii) Reward formulation — **CORRECTED** | `reward(pred, gold) = 1 − normalized_distance + ε · completion_bonus`, with `completion_bonus = 1` iff `0 < normalized_distance ≤ τ` AND structural envelope matches gold (length-bucket + element-count), else 0. If `normalized_distance > τ`, reward = floor = 0. Default ε = 1e-3. | Near-miss partial credit. At τ = 0 exact match, predicate false ⇒ bonus = 0 ⇒ reward = 1.0. At τ = 0 non-exact match, floor applied ⇒ reward = 0. Both equal `reward(EM)` pointwise. Bonus activates only over the strict near-miss band where partial credit is meaningful. | pending — formulation matches reviewer's correction; exact ε and completion criterion subject to confirmation |
| (iv) Threshold τ | Scalar training-time gate. Design-stage τ-grid = {0.0, 0.1, 0.25, 0.5, 1.0}. Headline τ = argmax of pre-registered primary metric; sensitivity reported across full grid. | τ = 0 must collapse MinED to EM (slot v). τ = 1.0 sets the gate to "always pass". | pending — paper may report different grid |
| (v) SANITY CONTROL = τ → 0 ⇒ EM — **CORRECTED** | Pre-computation gate: with τ = 0 on a 100-pair synthetic batch (exact matches, off-by-whitespace, off-by-letter, off-by-word, fully-disjoint, structural-envelope near-misses), assert pointwise `|reward_MinED − reward_EM| ≤ ε_sanity = 1e-6`. Under corrected (iii) the bonus-gate predicate is uniformly false at τ = 0, so equivalence holds strictly. Failure BLOCKS the run. | Slot (v)'s strongest claim — strict pointwise reward equivalence — survives path (a) without epsilon slack. Tier-1, universally-checkable. | confirmed-as-design-discipline |
| (vi) Stage of application | **Training-time reward PRIMARY**; **evaluation-time scoring SECONDARY** reporting | Training-time is where the criterion effects gradients; evaluation-time secondary reveals whether gains survive a metric-swap. | pending |

**Cross-cutting default (unchanged).** When `normalized_distance > τ`, reward collapses to floor = 0 (design-stage default; source-paper confirmation pending).

---

End of refinement. No new section, no expansion beyond slots (iii) and (v), other six sections remain approved.
